name: nh3h2o_absorption_ideal
title: Single-effect ammonia-water absorption cycle (ideal generator)
summary: Single-effect NH3-H2O absorption refrigeration cycle of the EES example Absorp.ees at one operating point: saturated vapour and weak solution at the generator outlet, no rectifier, pump work neglected, no refrigerant heat exchanger; solution heat exchanger with its effectiveness computed as an output; heat rates, COP and the 10 state points as arrays for the diagrams.
language_features: NH3H2O fluid (three of T, P, X, Q, H, S)

authors: S. A. Klein (University of Wisconsin-Madison / F-Chart Software)

verification.summary: Compared with the solution stored in Absorp.ees (EES 8.821): temperatures, compositions and SHX effectiveness within 0.3-2.4%; heat rates and COP within 2.8-9%, explained by the 2.4% composition difference between the two NH3H2O formulations (Ibrahim-Klein vs IAPWS G4-01) amplified by the circulation ratio; absolute h, s not comparable (different reference states).
verification.notes: max_rel_diff is the maximum over the comparable variables (temperatures, compositions, mass flows, heat rates, COP, epsilon); the absolute enthalpies/entropies carry the documented reference-state difference of the two NH3H2O formulations and four EES records carry mislabelled units (see README Verification).

history.action: added (import of EEL-014, the EES example Absorp.ees; simpler cycle than CSL-0249)
